task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 for ISS-0910. Write regression tests proving reset_role_claims_sync_markers/1's behavior in test/letflow/identity/role_backfill_test.exs (existing file, 7 tests already there per Step 3's report). Required test cases: (1) a user in a tenant that RoleBackfill.run/0 classifies :seeded, with role_claims_synced_at previously set (non-nil), has it reset to nil after run/0; (2) a user in a tenant classified :unchanged keeps their existing role_claims_synced_at value untouched; (3) running run/0 TWICE against the same seeded tenant is idempotent -- the second run classifies that tenant :unchanged (already fully seeded) and does not re-touch already-nil or already-re-synced markers; (4) the returned role_claims_markers_reset count matches the actual number of users whose marker was reset (not a hardcoded/approximate count).

This reset behavior is NEW (no pre-fix version existed -- WF-03's own 'pre-fix failure is non-existence' rule applies, see docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md). Prove discriminating power via mutation: apply at least 2 targeted mutants to the shipped reset_role_claims_sync_markers/1 or its call site (e.g. mutant A: call the reset unconditionally regardless of :seeded/:unchanged classification -- must fail test (2); mutant B: remove the prefix: schema_name option from the update_all call, defaulting to the public/global schema -- must fail test (1) or (2) depending on test DB setup, or cause an error test (4) catches via a wrong count) -- run the tests against each mutant, record which specific test(s) fail, then revert every mutation and verify (git status --porcelain lib/ test/ empty, suite re-runs green). Use a throwaway git worktree if practical.
acceptance_criteria: a test proves a :seeded tenant's users have role_claims_synced_at reset to nil
a test proves an :unchanged tenant's users are NOT touched
a test proves idempotency across two successive run/0 calls
a test proves the returned role_claims_markers_reset count is accurate, not approximate
at least 2 targeted mutants applied and reverted, with each one's specific test failure(s) recorded and the revert verified
